description: Hand-labeled ground-truth call-edges for PAYROLL.cbl. The accuracy oracle for legacy-code-intel's COBOL extractor (design §8). goldcheck.py computes call-edge precision/recall against this. Edges are identified by paragraph NAME (from_name -> to_name) so the gold is independent of any artifact content-hash. 'calls' covers both PERFORM (intra-program transfer) and CALL (inter-program). dynamic:true marks edges whose target is a data-name (must classify speculative, per HARD-RULE 2).
